page.title: Plugins
page.description: Give your agents new skills, subagents, commands and guardrails. These are Claude Code plugins: install them from GitHub, add one Godmode made, or write your own — and switch them off, update or remove them any time.
page.askPrompt: Write a Claude Code plugin for Godmode that

install.title: Install one
install.text: Pick a featured plugin, paste any GitHub repository, or add a small one Godmode made.

check.title: Godmode checks it with Claude Code
check.text: You see what it brings and what it can reach before it runs anywhere.

use.title: Your agents use it
use.text: Switched on, it loads into each run of the agents you choose. Updates are one click.

abilities.skillsDetail: Instructions the agent loads when a task needs them, or when you name them.
abilities.subagentsDetail: Specialists the agent can hand parts of its work to.
abilities.commandsDetail: Prompts you or the agent start with a /name.
abilities.hooksDetail: Shell commands on this computer on {{events}}.
abilities.hooksDetailMore: Shell commands on this computer on {{events}} and more.
abilities.mcpServersDetail: Programs on this computer that give the agent tools of their own.

runsFor.label: Runs for
runsFor.everyAgentHint: Every agent's runs load this plugin, the agents you add later too.
runsFor.appliesNext: Changes apply from the next message of each agent.

overview.staysOffCode: It stays off until you have read its code. Switching it on is your approval.
overview.refusedTitle: Claude Code refuses this plugin as it is
overview.refusedRepo: Runs don't load it. Update it, or check again after a Claude Code update.
overview.refusedCode: Runs don't load it until the problems below are fixed.

featured.title: Featured
featured.description: Popular Claude Code plugins, installed from GitHub in one click and kept up to date.
featured.missingHint: The plugin tells the agent when something is missing; the agent can install it for you.
featured.warning: Godmode downloads it from GitHub and checks it with Claude Code before it runs. It works with your agents' access and starts programs of its own on this computer.
featured.warningLicense: Godmode downloads it from GitHub and checks it with Claude Code before it runs. It works with your agents' access and starts programs of its own on this computer · {{license}} licence.

gallery.title: Made by Godmode
gallery.description: Small guardrail, privacy and workflow plugins that run inside every turn. Read the code of any of them before you add it.
gallery.empty: The gallery is empty on this version of Godmode.
gallery.secretOption: A secret you enter after adding the plugin.
gallery.setAfterAdding: You set its options and who it runs for after adding it.

sheet.discardDescription: What you changed in “{{title}}” since the last save is lost when you close it.
sheet.descriptionContents: A plugin: what it does and who it runs for, its options and its contents.
sheet.descriptionCode: A plugin: what it does and who it runs for, its options and its code.
sheet.nameHint: The plugin's name. It stays as it is: the plugin's own code refers to it.

newDialog.title: New plugin
newDialog.description: Give it a title. Its code opens next.
newDialog.nameStays: — it stays as it is once the plugin exists.

importDialog.fullPath: Enter the full path, starting at the root or with ~.
importDialog.title: Import a plugin folder
importDialog.description: A Claude Code plugin on the computer running Godmode — the folder that holds {{manifest}}.
importDialog.hint: The absolute path on that computer. Godmode copies the plugin's files and checks them; the folder itself stays as it is.
importDialog.pickDescription: The folder that holds {{manifest}}, on the computer running Godmode.

deleteDialog.descGit: Godmode removes the plugin, its downloaded files and its saved options. You can install it again any time.
deleteDialog.descLocal: Godmode forgets the plugin, its code and its saved options.

installDialog.invalid: Enter owner/repo, a GitHub link or a clone URL.
installDialog.title: Install from GitHub
installDialog.description: Any Claude Code plugin in a git repository: skills, subagents, commands, hooks and MCP servers. Godmode downloads it, checks it and keeps it up to date.
installDialog.hint: owner/repo, a GitHub link (also to a folder) or a clone URL.
installDialog.refHint: Updates follow it. Empty: the repository's default branch.
installDialog.enableHint: It loads into every agent's runs from the next message. Choose who runs it on its page.
installDialog.warning: Plugins work with your agents' access, and their hooks and servers start programs on this computer. Install the ones you trust.

options.needsValue: This plugin needs a value here.

options.secretRemoved: The saved value goes when you save
options.secretSaved: A value is saved — type to replace it
options.secretHint: Kept sealed in the vault. Runs that load this plugin are handed the value, where an agent with full access to this computer could read it — use a key made for this plugin.
options.unsavedHint: Unsaved changes. They apply from the next message once saved.
options.appliesNext: Changes apply from the next message.
options.folderDescription: A folder on the computer running Godmode.

code.noteSavedUnchecked: The saved code — your changes aren't checked yet
code.reviewHint: Read it through before anything else. Switching the plugin on is your approval: from then on it runs in every turn of the agents it is for.
code.staleTitle: The saved code changed while you were editing
code.staleHint: Saving replaces it with what you have here.
code.noFiles: This plugin has no files yet. Add one to start.
code.checkHint: Run Claude Code's validator over this draft, without saving
code.pathExists: A file with this path already exists.

code.deleteDescription: The file leaves the plugin when you save.
code.editorHint: Tab indents the code. Press Escape, then Tab, to leave the editor.

tools.label: Sees and changes tool calls
tools.detail: It can block a tool call, rewrite its input or act on its result.

prompts.label: Reads and rewrites prompts
prompts.detail: It sees what is sent to the agent and can change it, the system prompt included.

transcript.label: Edits what the conversation keeps
transcript.detail: It can rewrite messages and tool results before the model reads them.

turns.label: Follows the agent's turns
turns.detail: It is told when a turn starts, takes a step and ends.

notes.label: Posts notes into the chat
notes.detail: Its log lines, toasts and status show up in the chat as notes from the mod.

panes.label: Draws panes and bands
panes.detail: These show in Claude Code's own terminal and desktop app — not in Godmode's chats.

model.label: Calls the model
model.detail: It can ask Claude questions of its own, which costs tokens.

store.label: Remembers things between chats
store.detail: It keeps values of its own across sessions.

files_read.label: Reads files on this computer
files_read.detail: It can read any file the agent's run can read.

files_write.label: Writes files on this computer
files_write.detail: It can create and overwrite files.

process.label: Runs programs on this computer
process.detail: It can start commands of its own, outside the agent's tools.

network.label: Talks to the internet
network.detail: It can send requests to any server.

programs.label: Starts programs of its own
programs.detail: It ships command hooks, servers, monitors or scripts that Claude Code runs on this computer.
